description: China’s National Satellite Meteorological Center publishes three linked archive parts containing high-resolution meteorological drought indices. The article documents daily SPI, SPEI and a comprehensive MCI index over 1951–2022 at 0.1-degree resolution, derived from ERA5-Land precipitation and potential evapotranspiration. SPI and SPEI include thirty- and ninety-day scales, while MCI combines multiple accumulation periods. All three Zenodo pages identify public 7z bundles under CC BY 4.0. The national series can support drought-exposure and agricultural-water simulations. Validation is stronger in eastern China, and reanalysis uncertainty plus index construction limit interpretation as direct observations. The archive payloads were not inspected. The related data-era5-reanalysis describes the parent reanalysis family; these indices specifically use ERA5-Land inputs.
